queries.item: CREATE TABLE ?:yandex_delivery_requests ( yandex_delivery_request_id int(11) unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, shipment_id mediumint(8) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0', order_id mediumint(8) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0', shipping_id mediumint(8) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0', request_id varchar(128) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', operator_request_id varchar(128) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', status varchar(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', status_description varchar(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', sharing_url varchar(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', last_error text, created_at int(11) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0', updated_at int(11) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0', PRIMARY KEY (yandex_delivery_request_id), UNIQUE KEY shipment_id (shipment_id), KEY order_id (order_id, shipment_id), KEY request_id (request_id) ) ENGINE=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;
